findings.title: Malformed persisted deadline text is accepted as current lease authority
reproduction: Tick and claim a legitimate native activation with valid canonical instants and fixture finite profile.
Expire its stored lease with the existing fixture-only past UTC update. Preserve issued activation ID/generation; do not forge a new handle.
Inject native storage corruption by setting lease_until and execution_deadline to the non-Instant text not_an_instant.
Use the exact original handle to stage one saved intent ID and finish activation. Both methods return true on SQLite and PostgreSQL, committing state despite malformed, non-finite time authority.
findings.cause: Input operationTime, generated deadlines and DB now are canonical-validated, but locked persisted deadline fields are not. current() uses JavaScript string > and guarded UPDATE uses TEXT > canonical DB-now string. not_an_instant sorts after a UTC digit string in both, so invalid durable state passes both checks; the second write-time clock check does not repair missing type validity. claim's live-row predicate uses the same unvalidated comparisons.
findings.contract_impact: This is fail-closed durable storage corruption handling, expressly within requested review, not an authored capability exploit or protection against arbitrary privileged DB writes. Without valid persisted Instant authority, an expired/stale native handle must not checkpoint/clear durable work or block bounded recovery as if it had a finite live lease.
findings.required_correction: Validate canonical persisted lease_until/execution_deadline and the relevant active-state/null coherence under the same row lock before claim/live/current/checkpoint/finish decisions. Reuse strict Instant validation or a closed durable-row decoder; malformed durable times must produce a safe refusal/diagnostic with no state transition. Keep adapter DB-time reads after lock and final fenced write-time guards, generation and nested atomic rollback. Do not silently normalize invalid dates, treat arbitrary text as infinity or reinterpret corrupted deadlines as authorized completion.
acceptance: Add actual generated-native corruption regressions for invalid lease only, invalid execution deadline only, both malformed, null/inconsistent active deadlines and noncanonical/nonfinite forms on both adapters. Original valid handle cannot stage or finish; no page/cursor/activation/generation changes survive caught failure.
Retain all five focused groups, malformed/duplicate/extra persisted page rollback and generation-exhaustion controls.

Retain observed late-row-lock cases: elapsed lease permits a new higher-generation claim; old checkpoint and finish return false without mutating page; renewed activation uses fresh operation snapshot.
No new business/profile/worker choice is required; this is canonical persisted-state validation for the already accepted finite lease contract.
